item.title: Cloud IAM Lesson 1: Identity Model
item.description: Model human and workload principals, credentials, sessions, policies, roles, resources, and trust relationships across major cloud providers.

item.title: Cloud IAM Lesson 2: Effective Permissions
item.description: Evaluate cloud access across identity policies, resource policies, boundaries, hierarchy controls, conditions, inheritance, and explicit denies.

item.title: Cloud IAM Lesson 3: Human Access
item.description: Design federated human access with strong authentication, short sessions, privileged activation, emergency recovery, and continuous review.

item.title: Cloud IAM Lesson 4: Workload Identity
item.description: Design workload identity with federation, managed identities, service accounts, short-lived tokens, narrow roles, and verified rotation or revocation.

item.title: Cloud IAM Lesson 5: Zero Trust Policy
item.description: Turn zero trust principles into explicit cloud access decisions using identity, resource, device, workload, context, policy enforcement, and telemetry.

item.title: Cloud IAM Lesson 6: Disposable Provider Lab
item.description: Run a deterministic offline IAM simulator or create a read-only identity in one cloud sandbox, then record policy and teardown evidence.
